champions.name: Lee Sin
champions.title: the Blind Monk

abilities.P: Flurry: after ability, next 2 AAs gain AS + restore energy
abilities.Q: Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike: Q1 skillshot mark, Q2 dash to marked (execute scaling)
abilities.W: Safeguard/Iron Will: W1 dash to ally/ward, W2 lifesteal+spellvamp
abilities.E: Tempest/Cripple: E1 AoE reveal+damage, E2 slow nearby
abilities.R: Dragon's Rage: roundhouse kick target away, knocking up enemies hit by the target

champions.playstyle: Early game aggressor. Wardhop mobility. Insec kick (R enemy into team) is signature play.

champions.name: Leona
champions.title: the Radiant Dawn

abilities.P: Sunlight: abilities mark enemies; ally damage consumes mark for bonus magic damage
abilities.Q: Shield of Daybreak: AA reset + stun
abilities.W: Eclipse: gain armor/MR, then AoE damage. If hits enemy, keep resistances longer
abilities.E: Zenith Blade: skillshot through enemies, dash to last champion hit + root
abilities.R: Solar Flare: AoE stun (center) / slow (outer ring)

champions.playstyle: All-in engage support. E engage → Q stun → R for AoE. Tanky with W.

champions.name: Lillia
champions.title: the Bashful Bloom

abilities.P: Dream-Laden Bough: abilities apply Dream Dust dealing %max HP magic over time
abilities.Q: Blooming Blows: passive MS stacking. Active: AoE magic damage (outer edge = bonus)
abilities.W: Watch Out! Eep!: lob AoE at range dealing magic + slow
abilities.E: Swirlseed: long-range skillshot that rolls and slows on hit
abilities.R: Lilting Lullaby: put all Dream Dust-affected enemies to sleep after delay

champions.playstyle: Speed-ramping AP jungler. Q stacks MS. R puts entire team to sleep for wombo.

champions.name: Lissandra
champions.title: the Ice Witch

abilities.P: Iceborn Subjugation: killing enemy champ spawns Frozen Thrall that slows nearby enemies
abilities.Q: Ice Shard: line skillshot passing through enemies
abilities.W: Ring of Frost: AoE root around self
abilities.E: Glacial Path: send ice claw; recast to teleport to it
abilities.R: Frozen Tomb: self-cast = stasis + AoE. Enemy-cast = suppress target + AoE slow

champions.playstyle: Engage/lockdown mage. E to dive in, W root, R stasis for AoE. Anti-assassin with self-R.

champions.name: Lucian
champions.title: the Purifier

abilities.P: Lightslinger: after ability, next AA fires double shot
abilities.Q: Piercing Light: line damage through target (aimed from target)
abilities.W: Ardent Blaze: skillshot cross that marks + MS on hitting marked enemy
abilities.E: Relentless Pursuit: dash. CD reduced by Lightslinger hits
abilities.R: The Culling: channel rapid-fire shots in direction (can move during)

champions.playstyle: Combo ADC. Weave abilities + passive double-shots for burst DPS. Short range but high damage.

champions.name: Lulu
champions.title: the Fae Sorceress

abilities.P: Pix: companion fires bolts alongside ally's AAs (extra damage)
abilities.Q: Glitterlance: fire 2 bolts from Lulu+Pix, dealing magic damage + slow
abilities.W: Whimsy: ally = bonus AS+MS. Enemy = polymorph (silenced+slowed+can't AA)
abilities.E: Help, Pix!: ally = shield+Pix follows them. Enemy = reveal+Pix follows for Q aim
abilities.R: Wild Growth: target ally gains bonus HP + knockup nearby enemies + AoE slow aura

champions.playstyle: Top-tier enchanter. W polymorph shuts down assassins. R saves carries with HP+knockup.

champions.name: Lux
champions.title: the Lady of Luminosity

abilities.P: Illumination: abilities mark enemies. AA or R consume for bonus magic damage
abilities.Q: Light Binding: skillshot root (hits 2 targets, roots both)
abilities.W: Prismatic Barrier: throw wand out+back, shielding allies hit both ways
abilities.E: Lucent Singularity: AoE zone + slow; recast for damage
abilities.R: Final Spark: massive long-range laser dealing magic damage. Low CD with passive procs.

champions.playstyle: Long-range burst mage. Q root → E → R combo for kills. W shields team. Safe poke.

champions.name: Malphite
champions.title: Shard of the Monolith

abilities.P: Granite Shield: out of combat, gain shield = 10% max HP
abilities.Q: Seismic Shard: point-click magic damage + steal MS from target
abilities.W: Thunderclap: passive armor bonus. Active: AA cleave dealing bonus damage (scales with armor)
abilities.E: Ground Slam: AoE magic damage + reduce nearby enemy AS (scales with armor)
abilities.R: Unstoppable Force: dash to location, AoE knockup + magic damage. THE teamfight engage.

champions.playstyle: Tank with game-winning R engage. Stacks armor. R into enemy team = instant teamfight win.

champions.name: Maokai
champions.title: the Twisted Treant

abilities.P: Sap Magic: after nearby abilities cast, next AA heals based on max HP
abilities.Q: Bramble Smash: AoE knockback + slow in line
abilities.W: Twisted Advance: point-click dash + root on enemy
abilities.E: Sapling Toss: throw sapling that wards area + chases enemies (more damage in brush)
abilities.R: Nature's Grasp: send massive root wave that roots first enemies hit (wider over distance)

champions.playstyle: CC tank support/jungle. W point-click root. R massive engage tool. E for vision.

champions.name: Master Yi
champions.title: the Wuju Bladesman

abilities.P: Double Strike: every few AAs, strike twice
abilities.Q: Alpha Strike: become untargetable, bounce between nearby enemies dealing damage. Resets on kill.
abilities.W: Meditate: channel healing + damage reduction. AA reset after
abilities.E: Wuju Style: passive: bonus AD. Active: AAs deal bonus true damage for 5s
abilities.R: Highlander: massive AS+MS, immune to slows. Duration extends on takedowns. CD resets on kill.

champions.playstyle: Hypercarry melee. R = unstoppable. Q dodges abilities. Resets on kills = pentakill potential.

champions.name: Mel
champions.title: the Rogue of Radiance

abilities.P: Reverberation: abilities empower next AA with bonus magic damage
abilities.Q: Glaring Spell: fire light projectile dealing magic damage + slow
abilities.W: Shimmering Veil: shield self. If shield breaks or expires, deal AoE magic damage
abilities.E: Ray of Annihilation: channel beam in direction dealing sustained magic damage
abilities.R: Blinding Brilliance: massive AoE damage + marking low-HP enemies for execute damage

champions.playstyle: Burst mage with execution R. W shield for safety. Combo-oriented.

champions.name: Milio
champions.title: the Gentle Flame

abilities.P: Fired Up!: enchanted allies' AAs deal bonus magic damage + burn
abilities.Q: Ultra Mega Fire Kick: skillshot that knocks back + deals damage + applies passive
abilities.W: Cozy Campfire: place healing zone that follows ally. Grants heal + bonus range
abilities.E: Warm Hugs: shield ally + bonus MS
abilities.R: Breath of Life: AoE cleanse all CC from nearby allies + heal

champions.playstyle: Protective enchanter. W zone heals and extends range. R is AoE Mikael's (team cleanse).

champions.name: Miss Fortune
champions.title: the Bounty Hunter

abilities.P: Love Tap: AAs deal bonus damage when switching targets
abilities.Q: Double Up: AA that bounces to target behind. Bonus damage if first target dies.
abilities.W: Strut: passive MS when not hit. Active: bonus AS
abilities.E: Make It Rain: AoE slow + magic damage zone
abilities.R: Bullet Time: channel massive cone of bullets dealing physical damage

champions.playstyle: Lane bully ADC. Q bounce poke. R is devastating in narrow fights/objectives.

champions.name: Mordekaiser
champions.title: the Iron Revenant

abilities.P: Darkness Rise: after 3 hits, gain AoE damage aura + MS
abilities.Q: Obliterate: smash ground dealing magic damage (isolated = bonus)
abilities.W: Indestructible: store damage dealt/taken as shield. Recast to heal
abilities.E: Death's Grasp: pull enemies toward you in a cone
abilities.R: Realm of Death: banish target to 1v1 shadow realm. Steal % of their stats. If you kill them, keep stats.

champions.playstyle: AP juggernaut. R forces 1v1 anyone. Passive aura melts in extended fights.

champions.name: Morgana
champions.title: the Fallen

abilities.P: Soul Siphon: heal for % of ability damage dealt to champions
abilities.Q: Dark Binding: long-range root skillshot (2-3 second root!)
abilities.W: Tormented Shadow: AoE pool dealing %missing HP magic damage
abilities.E: Black Shield: spell shield on ally that blocks CC + magic damage
abilities.R: Soul Shackles: AoE chains to nearby enemies. After 3s, stun + damage if still in range

champions.playstyle: Anti-engage support. E spell shield blocks all CC. Q has longest root in game.

champions.name: Nami
champions.title: the Tidecaller

abilities.P: Surging Tides: abilities grant allies MS when hit
abilities.Q: Aqua Prison: AoE bubble skillshot → suspend (knockup equivalent)
abilities.W: Ebb and Flow: bouncing heal/damage between allies and enemies (up to 3 bounces)
abilities.E: Tidecaller's Blessing: empower ally AAs with bonus magic damage + slow
abilities.R: Tidal Wave: long-range wave that knocks up + slows enemies hit

champions.playstyle: Complete enchanter. Q bubble is strong CC. W heals+damages. E empowers carry. R engage/disengage.

champions.name: Nasus
champions.title: the Curator of the Sands

abilities.P: Soul Eater: lifesteal on AAs
abilities.Q: Siphoning Strike: AA reset. Permanently stacks +3 per minion kill (+12 per champ/large monster). Infinite scaling.
abilities.W: Wither: point-click massive slow + AS slow on target
abilities.E: Spirit Fire: AoE armor shred zone + magic damage
abilities.R: Fury of the Sands: grow + bonus HP + AoE %max HP magic/s + reduced Q CD during

champions.playstyle: Infinite scaling juggernaut. Farm Q stacks. Late game 1v9 with 500+ stacks.

champions.name: Nautilus
champions.title: the Titan of the Depths

abilities.P: Staggering Blow: first AA on each enemy roots them briefly
abilities.Q: Dredge Line: hook skillshot. Pulls you to target (pulls target to you if champion)
abilities.W: Titan's Wrath: gain shield. While shield holds, AAs deal bonus magic damage
abilities.E: Riptide: 3 AoE waves of magic damage + slow around self
abilities.R: Depth Charge: point-click: send shockwave that knocks up target + all enemies in path

champions.playstyle: CC machine support. Every ability has CC. R is point-click knockup. Q hook engage.

champions.name: Nidalee
champions.title: the Bestial Huntress

abilities.P: Prowl: moving through brush grants MS. Hitting Q/trap marks target as Hunted (bonus cougar damage)
abilities.Q: Human Q: Javelin Toss (long range spear, more damage at distance). Cougar Q: Takedown (execute)
abilities.W: Human W: Bushwhack (trap). Cougar W: Pounce (dash, reset on Hunted kill)
abilities.E: Human E: Primal Surge (heal + AS buff). Cougar E: Swipe (AoE damage)
abilities.R: Aspect of the Cougar: transform between human (ranged, utility) and cougar (melee, burst) at level 1

champions.playstyle: High-skill form-swap jungler. Spear poke → cougar burst. Early game power. Heals allies.

champions.name: Nilah
champions.title: the Joy Unbound

abilities.P: Joy Unending: share nearby ally heals/shields. Gain bonus XP from minion kills
abilities.Q: Formless Blade: empower AA with whip range + bonus damage + armor pen
abilities.W: Jubilant Veil: MS + dodge all AAs briefly. Extends to nearby allies on touch
abilities.E: Slipstream: dash through target dealing damage
abilities.R: Apotheosis: whirlwind AoE pulling enemies in → burst damage + heal based on damage dealt

champions.playstyle: Melee ADC with dodge. W blocks all AAs. R pull + heal in teamfights. Needs specific support.

champions.name: Nocturne
champions.title: the Eternal Nightmare

abilities.P: Umbra Blades: every few AAs, AoE cleave + heal
abilities.Q: Duskbringer: line skillshot leaving trail. On trail: bonus AD + MS
abilities.W: Shroud of Darkness: passive AS. Active: spell shield for 1.5s. If blocked, doubled AS.
abilities.E: Unspeakable Horror: tether fear after 2s. Target feared if in range
abilities.R: Paranoia: remove ALL enemy vision (darkness). Recast: dash to target enemy champion

champions.playstyle: Dive assassin jungler. R darkness = terror. Dive carries with no counterplay vision.

champions.name: Norra
champions.title: the Magician's Cat

abilities.P: Yuumi's Blessing: portals between two locations. Both Norra and allies can use them
abilities.Q: Tail Whip: throw projectile that bounces off portals for bonus damage
abilities.W: Zoomies: shield ally + bonus MS. Through portal = enhanced
abilities.E: Channel: place/move portals connecting two locations
abilities.R: Mega Womp: massive AoE through portal dealing magic damage + stun

champions.playstyle: Portal mage. Unique map control with portals. Abilities interact with portal system.

champions.name: Nunu & Willump
champions.title: the Boy and His Yeti

abilities.P: Call of the Freljord: nearby ally with highest AS gains bonus AS. AAs deal bonus magic
abilities.Q: Consume: bite target dealing true damage + heal. Bonus effects vs monsters
abilities.W: Biggest Snowball Ever!: roll snowball (grows bigger) → AoE knockup + damage on release/collision
abilities.E: Snowball Barrage: throw 3 volleys of snowballs + root at end if 3 volleys hit
abilities.R: Absolute Zero: channel massive AoE slow → burst damage + shield. More charge = more damage

champions.playstyle: Engage/objective jungle tank. W snowball for engage. Q smite for objectives. R for zone control.
